mentions.name: Stelae
mentions.description: This tool lets users author sites in WordPress as usual inside their own Docker container, with the full editor and plugins, then exports the site to static HTML for the public version so PHP doesn't run in front of readers. Deploy targets are Cloudflare Pages, a Git remote, or statichost.eu. Solo-built, just launched, and currently being hardened.
mentions.problem: Public WordPress sites run PHP in front of readers; this exports the site to static HTML instead.
